# Komoka Plumbing

> Komoka Plumbing is a local HVAC company serving Komoka, Middlesex, Ontario, offering furnace repair, AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump repair and installation, fireplace installation, thermostat repair, and duct cleaning to homeowners across the region.
